rows.title: hr leave requests handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] hr leave requests records verified in status "submitted" must be moved to status "rejected". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: hr leave requests handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For hr leave requests records verified in status "submitted": if the record's leave_type is "bereavement", move it to status "approved"; otherwise move it to status "rejected". Apply exactly one transition.

rows.title: hr leave requests handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For hr leave requests records verified in status "submitted": if the record's leave_type is "parental", move it to status "approved"; otherwise move it to status "rejected". Apply exactly one transition.
